text:
sara: Heads up — ap-southeast keystore rotation finished ~15m ago and we're seeing an audit-shipper QPS spike. NAT conntrack ~98%, GPU node joins delayed, some nodes stuck in Pending. Anyone else?
raj: yup seeing the same in ap-southeast-1, kube events show image pull/attach waits and S3 egress is ~3x baseline. GPU warm pools not filling.
leo: quick grep of shipper logs -> we started shipping full event payloads instead of sampled summaries after the rotation. looks like client lib fell back to sample_rate=1.0.
jin: oof. config rollback snippet:
```yaml
# shipper-config.yaml
sampling_rate: 1.0  # should have been 0.01
compress: false
```
ops-bot: ALERT: natgw-apac-01 conntrack_utilization=98% threshold=90%
taylor: can we apply a temporary egress ACL or iptables rate-limit on the shipper pods to stop hammering the NAT?
sara: i'm going to canary a config patch to lower sampling + enable compression on two shipper replicas in apac. will watch conntrack and GPU join. :eyes:
raj: question — is the KMS rotation triggering re-encrypts/read-amplification? could be extra decrypt calls causing higher keystore traffic too.
leo: yes, the rotation flip accidentally enabled reencrypt-on-read (`reencrypt: true`) in the keystore rollout. that makes clients read whole blobs to rewrap them. rolling that flag back should cut keystore I/O.
jin: patch ready, applying to apac-canary: `sampling_rate: 0.05`, `compress: true`. restarting pods.
sara: applied patch to 2 replicas, conntrack dropped to 65% within 3m, cpu on shipper pods down 40%. GPU nodes are starting to join warm pool again.
taylor: nice. quick ops note — please tag the extra NAT egress to cost-center infra-rls for chargeback. estimate ~ $3.2k egress over last 2 hours.
leo: created a short runbook entry for keystore rotation checklist -> ensure `reencrypt` off and client sampling preserved. link: https://internal/rw/runbooks/keystore-rotation (will add steps).
sara: rolling the keystore flag back now. doing controlled rollout to avoid flapping.
ops-bot: TICKET CREATED: INC-2026-3305 "apac keystore rotation -> audit shipper QPS surge" assigned to eng-sre oncall.
raj: postmortem items: action items: (1) add automated sampling regression test to keystore CI, (2) throttle shipper default egress at node iptables, (3) cost alert for NAT egress anomalies.
jin: agree. i'll open PRs for CI test + shipper default config change.
taylor: i'll own the cost/finance summary for the incident.
sara: thanks team. i'll leave a short summary in #postmortems after we collect metrics. closing the immediate fire — monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:
